y-m-36-02.title: Ukwazi ingcambu enye kumisela imilinganiselo?
y-m-36-02.topic: Ingcambu enye yolingano lwe-quadratic nolwazi olufunekayo ukumisela imilinganiselo
y-m-36-02.goal: Bala ukuba ingaphi imilinganiselo ekumiselwa lulwazi 'ingcambu enye inikiwe', khetha ulwazi olongezelelweyo olwaneleyo ukumisela imilinganiselo ibe yimpendulo enye, uze wakhe umzekelo oyanelisa iimeko wena.
y-m-36-02.material: Kulingano lwe-quadratic x² + ax + b = 0 (a no-b ngamanani eqinisileyo), konke okwaziwayo kukuba x = 2 yingcambu. USoyeong wathi, "Ukuba ufaka x = 2, ungafumana a no-b," yaye uDaon wathi, "Oko kodwa akonelanga njengolwazi." (Funda njenge: x isikwere kunye a x kunye b kulingana no-0)
y-m-36-02.thinking.0: Ukuthelekisa inani lolwazi (inani leemlinganiselo) nenani lezinto ezingaziwayo ukufumana
y-m-36-02.thinking.1: Ukuvavanya omnye emva komnye ukuba ulwazi olongezelelweyo lwanele
y-m-36-02.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yengcambu yolingano (ukufaka ingcambu kwenza ulingano lube nyani)
y-m-36-02.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kweengcambu ezimbini zolingano lwe-quadratic nemilinganiselo yalo (inqanaba lecandelo leemlinganiselo kwiBanga 10) — I-H2 yalo msebenzi yinqanaba lobunzima nenkxaso kuphela kwesi sabelo sokuvelisa; ayithethi ukuba isicwangciso semfundo sabela loo mpawu kuloo banga. Thatha ukuba ulwazi olufunekayo olungezantsi sele lufundiwe.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.prompt: Thelekisa oko kwathethwa nguSoyeong noDaon, uze ukhethe ugwebo olufanelekileyo kakhulu ngolwazi olwaziwayo ngoku.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.hint.0: Faka a = 0, 1, −1 enye ngexesha, uze ulungise b ukuze x = 2 ibe yingcambu.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuba zonke izibini ozenzileyo zanelisa iimeko. Ukuba kunjalo, zingaphi iimpendulo?
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.a: Ulingano olunye olufumanayo ngokufaka x = 2 lukuvumela ukuba ufumane zombini a no-b.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.a: Oku kuthatha ulingano olunye njengolunokumisela izinto ezimbini ezingaziwayo. Zama ukufumana ukuba b iba yintoni xa a ingu-0, 1, no-−1.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.b: Ukuba x = 2 yingcambu, ngoko b kufuneka ibe ngu-0.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.b: Awuhlolanga ukuba likho isizathu sokuba b ibe ngu-0 xa ingcambu ingengo-0. Fumana b xa a = 0.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.c: Kuba ingcambu enye kuphela enikiwe, olu lingano kufuneka lube nengcambu ephindiweyo.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.c: Olu gwebo luthatha 'ingcambu enye eyaziwayo' no 'ngcambu enye kuphela' njengento enye. Fumana zonke iingcambu xa a = −1.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.d: Ukufaka kunika ulingano olunye kuphela, ngoko a no-b azinakumiselwa zibe yimpendulo enye.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.d: Olu gwebo luthelekisa inani lezinto ezingaziwayo nenani leemlinganiselo ezifunyenweyo.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.explain: Ukufaka x = 2 kunika ulingano olunye, 4 + 2a + b = 0. Kukho izinto ezimbini ezingaziwayo, a no-b, ngoko izibini ezingenasiphelo zinokwenzeka, ezinje nge-(a, b) = (0, −4), (−1, −2), (1, −6). Ngenxa nje yokuba ingcambu enye inikiwe akuthethi ukuba enye ingcambu inexabiso elifanayo.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.prompt: Masithi nganye inikwa ngokwahlukileyo. Khetha lonke ulwazi olongezelelweyo olwaneleyo ukumisela a no-b zibe yimpendulo enye.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, bhala ulwazi olutsha njengolingano uze ulusombulule kunye nolingano osele unalo, 4 + 2a + b = 0, uze ubale ukuba zingaphi izibini (a, b) eziphumayo.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kukhetho olungamiseli mpendulo, hlola ngokwenza izibini ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezanelisa imeko.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.a: Uhlolile ukuba ukwazi zombini iingcambu kumisela a no-b ngesixa nesiphumo.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.b: Esi sigqibo sikhangela ukuba ungafumana b ngokudibanisa nolingano osele unalo, 4 + 2a + b = 0.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.c: Awuzange ubale ukuba zingaphi izibini ezanelisa 4 + 2a + b = 0 imeko yamanani aphelele ezishiyayo. (0, −4) kunye (−2, 0) zombini ziizibini zamanani aphelele.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.d: Awuzange uhlule ulwazi olucutha uluhlu kolo lumisela impendulo enye. Zininzi nezibini (a, b) ezanelisa le meko.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.e: Esi sigqibo sikhangela ukuba ubudlelwane obunikwe ngoku, kunye nolingano lokuqala, benza amalingano amabini na.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.explain: Ukuba enye irutu ingu-−3, ngoko isixa −1 = −a kunye nemveliso −6 = b ziyamisela. Ukuba a = −1, ngoko b = −2. Ukuba b = a + 2, ngoko 4 + 2a + a + 2 = 0 inika a = −2, b = 0. Imeko yamanani aphelele kunye nemeko 'yamanani okwenyani ahlukeneyo' zicutha uluhlu kuphela, yaye izibini ezininzi ziyasala.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.prompt: Ngeli xesha, yenza izibini ezimbini ezahlukeneyo (a, b) apho a no-b ngamanani aphelele kwaye iirutu ezimbini ze-x² + ax + b = 0 ziimani zokwenyani eziphezulu ezahlukeneyo, enye kuzo ingu-2.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala usebenzise 4 + 2a + b = 0 ukuhambisa b no-a, uze uchaze ngokwa-a ukuba enye irutu yintoni.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.hint.1: Zama amaxabiso ambalwa e-a ukuze enye irutu ibe phezulu kwaye ingabi ngu-2.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Nceda wenze zombini a no-b zibe ngamanani aphelele.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Xa ufaka x = 2, intetho ayibi ngu-0.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c3: Enye irutu ayiphezulu okanye ilingana no-2, ngoko ayinikeli 'iirutu ezimbini eziphezulu ezahlukeneyo.'
y-m-36-02.s.s3.explain: Umzekelo, (a, b) = (−3, 2) inika x² − 3x + 2 = (x − 1)(x − 2), enamarutu 1 no-2, kwaye (−5, 6) inika iirutu 2 no-3. (−4, 4) inerutu enye kuphela, 2 (irutu ephindiweyo), kwaye (−1, −2) inerutu yesibini −1, ngoko zombini azihambelani neemeko. Izibini ezininzi zanelisa zonke ezi meko, ngoko unokuqinisekisa kwakhona ukuba iimeko azimiseli mpendulo inye.

y-m-36-09.title: Ulingano lwe-quadratic apho isixa nemveliso zombini zipositivu
y-m-36-09.topic: Iimpawu zeengcambu ezimbini zolingano lwe-quadratic neemeko kwisixa nemveliso
y-m-36-09.goal: Fumana imeko elahlekileyo kwisibakala esithi "ukuba isixa nemveliso zombini zipositivu, zombini iingcambu zipositivu" ngokwakha umzekelo ochasayo ngokwakho, uze ulungise isibakala ukuze sibe yinyani.
y-m-36-09.material: UMina wenza isibakala: "Kulingano lwe-quadratic x² − sx + q = 0 (s no-q ngamanani enyani), ukuba isixa s nemveliso q yeengcambu ezimbini zombini zipositivu, ngoko zombini iingcambu ngamanani enyani apositivu." (Funda njenge: x isikwere ukhuphe s x udibanise q lilingana no-0) Isixa seengcambu ezimbini yi-s kwaye imveliso yi-q.

y-m-36-09.thinking.1: Yakha umzekelo ochasayo oneliselayo imeko kodwa ophula isigqibo
y-m-36-09.thinking.2: Lungisa isibakala ngokongeza imeko apho sisebenza khona
y-m-36-09.prereq.0: Ubudlelwane obuchaza isixa nemveliso yeengcambu ezimbini zolingano lwe-quadratic ngokwamakoyifishenti alo

Cinga ukuba ulwazi lwangaphambili olungezantsi sele lufundiwe.

y-m-36-09.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga ukuba zikhona na iimeko apho iingcambu zingengo zenyani, uze usebenze ukuba isigqibo "amanani enyani apositivu" sisachanekile kuloo meko.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.a: Isebenza kuphela xa isixa sipositivu kwaye imveliso inegethivu.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.a: Ufunde ngokubuyela umva ubudlelwane bokuba ukuba imveliso ipositivu, iingcambu ezimbini zinophawu olufanayo.

y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.b: Ulibale ukuba ukuba imveliso ipositivu, iingcambu ezimbini zenyani zinophawu olufanayo. Umzekelo, yakha iimbini ezimbalwa zeengcambu ezimbini zenyani apho isixa sipositivu kwaye imveliso ipositivu.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.c: Isoloko isebenza. Ukuba isixa nemveliso zipositivu, zombini iingcambu zipositivu.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.c: Awuzange uvavanye imizekelo echasayo ukubona ukuba iimpawu zesixa nemveliso zodwa zinele na.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.d: Isenokungasebenzi. Zikhona iimeko apho iingcambu zingengo zenyani.

y-m-36-09.s.s1.explain: Ukuba imveliso ipositivu kwaye zombini iingcambu zenyani, iingcambu ezimbini zinophawu olufanayo, kwaye ukuba isixa sipositivu, zombini zipositivu. Kodwa ukuba iingcambu azizozenyani, oko kukuthi, iingcambu ezingeyonyani, igama elithi "uphawu" alinakusetyenziswa, kwaye isixa nemveliso zisenokuba zipositivu. Umzekelo, iingcambu ze-x² − 2x + 5 = 0 zi-1 ± 2i.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.prompt: Yenza iimbini ezimbini ezahlukileyo (s, q) eziphula isibakala sikaMina. Isixa s nemveliso q zombini zipositivu, kodwa iingcambu ezimbini zolingano x² − sx + q = 0 akufuneki zibe ngamanani enyani apositivu.

y-m-36-08.title: Esiphi kwezi zisombululo ezimbini esiza kuqhubeka sibaluleke?
y-m-36-08.topic: Iingcambu ezipheleleyo zolingano lwekyubhiki nokuthelekisa iindlela zokusombulula
y-m-36-08.goal: Thelekisa iindlela ezimbini zokusombulula, uvavanye ukuba phantsi kweemeko ezinjani nganye inokusetyenziswa, uze wenze icebo lokusombulula ngokwakha ulingano lwekyubhiki oluneengcambu ezipheleleyo wena.
y-m-36-08.material: UHajun noSeoyun basombulule ulingano lwekyubhiki x³ − 2x² − x + 2 = 0. UHajun: udibanise amalungu amabini okuqala namalungu amabini okugqibela waguqula kwaba yi-x²(x − 2) − (x − 2) = (x − 2)(x² − 1). USeoyun: efake x = 1, waqinisekisa ukuba inika i-0, wahlula nge-x − 1 efumana (x − 1)(x² − x − 2). Bobabini bafumene iingcambu −1, 1, 2. (Funda: x ikyubhiki ukususa 2x isikwere ukususa x kudibaniswe no-2 lilingana no-0)
y-m-36-08.thinking.0: Thelekisa uze uvavanye iindlela zokusombulula komnye komnye
y-m-36-08.thinking.1: Gweba ukuba indlela inokuqhubeka isetyenziswa na xa iimeko zitshintsha
y-m-36-08.prereq.0: Umgaqo wento ebalayo nokwahlula okudityanisiweyo (ukwahlula i-polynomial ngentetho yomgca)
y-m-36-08.prereq.1: Inyani yokuba abagqatswa beengcambu eziphelele zolingano olunamakoyifishenti aphelele ngabahluli belungu eliqhelekileyo (inqanaba lecandelo lezilingano lebanga le-10) — I-H2 yalo msebenzi sisinyuko sobunzima nenkxaso kuphela kule nkcitho yemveliso; ayithethi ukuba isicwangciso semfundo sinika elo candelo kuloo bhanga. Cinga ukuba ulwazi olufunekayo olungezantsi sele lufundiwe.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi eyona nkcazo ifanelekileyo ethelekisa izisombululo ezimbini?

y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.d: Iimpendulo ziyafana, ngoko akukho ntsingiselo yokuvavanya iindlela ngokwahlukeneyo.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.d: Awuzange wahlule inyaniso yokuba iimpendulo ziyafana kwindlela ekubeni indlela iqhelekile kangakanani.

Zombini ziibalo ezichanekileyo, kwaye iimeko ezizisebenzisayo ziyahluka. Le ngxaki yanelisa zombini iimeko, ngoko zombini zisebenzile.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.prompt: Tshintsha ilungu eliqhelekileyo ukuze ulingano libe x³ − 2x² − x + 3 = 0. Sesiphi isitatimenti esichanekileyo ngeli binzana?

y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukuba awazi ukuba p no-q ngamanani onjani, enye irutu inokuba yinto nayiphi na. Isigqibo esinyanisekileyo kweli nyathelo kukuthi ayinakumiselwa. Ukuba ucinge ngaphandle kokuthi "p no-q ziyinyani" waphendula nge-1 − i, uya kukhangela kwinyathelo elilandelayo ukuba esi sithembiso sinikwe ngenene njengolwazi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ingxaki ayithi p no-q ngamanani okwenyani, kodwa unokuba ubucinge ngokunjalo. Ukuba usebenzise isithembiso, kuhle ukusibhala.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Akukho lwazi malunga no-p no-q, ngoko ayinakumiselwa.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Awuzange ucinge ulwazi olungenikwanga, waza wabambezela isigqibo sakho.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Unokuba ucinge ngomthetho wokujika zonke iimpawu. Ude ukhangele isixa nemveliso ngokwakho, akukho siseko soko.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Esi sigqibo sithatha "enye irutu iyaziwa" kunye "iirutu ziyahlangana" njengezinto ezifanayo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ulwazi olutsha: p no-q zombini ngamanani okwenyani. Ukuba enye irutu yi-s + ti (s no-t ngamanani okwenyani), isixa seerutu ezimbini (1 + s) + (1 + t)i kunye nemveliso (s − t) + (s + t)i kufuneka zombini zibe ngamanani okwenyani. (Imveliso yi-(1 + i)(s + ti) = s + ti + si + ti² ilula.)
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuze isixa sibe sokwenyani, 1 + t = 0, ngoko t = −1, kwaye ukuze imveliso ibe yokwenyani, s + t = 0, ngoko s = 1. Ngoko enye irutu yi-1 − i. Isigqibo sangaphambili sokuba ayinakugqitywa sasilunge kuba ulwazi lwalungonelanga, kwaye ngoku sitshintshile kuba ulwazi lunyukile.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ulinganise kuphela inxalenye engeyiyo ukuze isixa sibe sokwenyani yaye awukhangelanga imveliso. Cinga ukuba imveliso iyinyani na.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukuba iirutu ezimbini ziyafana, isixa 2 + 2i asilolo inani lokwenyani. Khangela ukuba isixa siyinyani na.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ulwazi olutsha lunika amalingano amabini, isixa nemveliso, kodwa waqhubeka ubambezela isigqibo sakho njengangaphambili.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Lixabiso olifumana ngokufumana s no-t ezenza zombini isixa nemveliso zibe zezokwenyani.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Sitshintsha isiqwenga esinye solwazi. Ngeli xesha, silahla isitatimenti sokuba p no-q zezokwenyani, size sithi enye irutu yi-2. Ngoko x² + px + q = (x − (1 + i))(x − 2) = x² − (3 + i)x + (2 + 2i), ngoko p = −3 − i kunye q = 2 + 2i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kulo mzekelo, p = −3 − i kunye q = 2 + 2i asiyiyo imani yokwenyani, ngoko yimeko engaphandle kwesithembiso esithi "iikoyifishenti zezokwenyani." Ngaphandle kwaso eso sithembiso, awunakuthi irutu enye 1 + i yodwa yenza enye irutu ibe yi-1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ngaphandle kwesithembiso sokuba p no-q zezokwenyani, awunakuthi enye irutu yi-1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uhlule ukuba ipropathi yerutu ye-conjugate imi kwesiphi isithembiso.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ukuba enye irutu yi-1 + i, enye ihlala iyi-1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Jonga kwakhona ukuba enye irutu yintoni kumzekelo esiwenze ngoku nje.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Iirutu zolingano lwe-quadratic zihlala zinani elinye lokwenyani nenye engeyiyo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Iirutu ezimbini 1 + i kunye 2 kulo mzekelo zinokubonakala njengesibini esinjalo, kodwa uhlobo lweerutu luxhomekeke kwiikoyifishenti. Cinga ngemeko apho zombini iirutu ziyinyani xa iikoyifishenti ziyinyani.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Nokuba p no-q ziyinyani, enye irutu inokungabi yi-1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: U-p no-q kulo mzekelo azizizo ezokwenyani. Khangela ukuba umzekelo wenziwe phantsi kweemeko ezintoni.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.info: Ulwazi lokugqibela: kwakhona p no-q zezokwenyani, kodwa ngeli xesha enye irutu yi-1 + √2, engeyiyo. Umzekelo, ukuba enye irutu yi-3, ngoko (x − (1 + √2))(x − 3) = x² − (4 + √2)x + 3 + 3√2, kwaye apha p = −4 − √2 kunye q = 3 + 3√2 zombini zezokwenyani.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.after: Imeko yokuba p no-q zezokwenyani yodwa ayimiseli enye irutu njenge-1 − √2. I-1 − √2 iqinisekiswa kuphela xa kukho imeko eqinileyo yokuba p no-q ziyimilinganiselo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Ukuba p no-q zezokwenyani, ihlala iyi-1 − √2.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Jonga ukuba enye irutu yintoni kumzekelo esisandula ukuwunika.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Kufuneka ibe yirutu ephindiweyo, efana ne-1 + √2.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Esi sigqibo sithatha "enye irutu iyaziwa" kunye "irutu ephindiweyo" njengezinto ezifanayo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Uthwale umthetho osetyenziswe kwiirutu ezingeyiyo, utshintsha uphawu kuphela. Khangela isixa nemveliso.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Ayinakumiselwa. Nokuba enye irutu yi-3, p no-q ziyinyani.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Uqinisekise ngomzekelo ukuba imeko yeekoyifishenti zokwenyani yodwa ayonelanga.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni kwakungekho lwazi, ngoko "ayinakumiselwa" yayiyisigqibo esilungileyo, kwaye xa kwafika ulwazi "p no-q zezokwenyani", isigqibo satshintshela kwi-1 − i. Kumanyathelo amabini alandelayo, ukhangele ngemizekelo phantsi kweemeko ezintoni umthetho ofanayo uyaphuka. Jonga umva ukuba loluphi ulwazi olwafika nesigqibo esitshintshileyo, okanye ukuba kwakulungile ukusigcina njengoko sinjalo.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.prompt: Khetha zonke iimeko apho "enye irutu imiselwe ngokuyimfuneko njenge-conjugate (imo enophawu kuphela olutshintshiweyo)."
y-m-36-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, khetha ngokukhululekileyo enye irutu, uze ukhangele ukuba p no-q ziyanelisa imeko yokhetho na.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ukhetho apho nomzekelo omnye ochasayo owanelisa imeko ungakhiwa alukho "ngokuyimfuneko."
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.a: Enye irutu yolingano lwe-quadratic apho zonke iikoyifishenti zezokwenyani yi-3 − 2i
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.a: Ukhangele ukuba zombini iimeko ziyakhona: irutu engeyiyo inikiwe kwaye iikoyifishenti zezokwenyani.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.b: Enye irutu yolingano lwe-quadratic apho iikoyifishenti ziimani ezinkimbinkimbi yi-3 − 2i
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.b: Khumbula umzekelo ochasayo wenyathelo langaphambili, uze ucinge ukuba lo mthetho uqinisekisiwe xa kungekho sithembiso sokuba iikoyifishenti zezokwenyani.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.c: Enye irutu yolingano lwe-quadratic apho zonke iikoyifishenti ziimilinganiselo yi-2 + √3
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.c: Esi sigqibo sihlula ukuba yeyiphi imeko kwiikoyifishenti efuneka ukuze umthetho ubambe nakwiirutu zokwenyani.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.d: Enye irutu yolingano lwe-quadratic apho zonke iikoyifishenti zezokwenyani yi-2 + √3
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.d: Esi sigqibo sithatha iimeko ezifunekayo kwiirutu ezingeyiyo nakwiirutu ezingenangqiqo njengezifanayo. Cinga ngomzekelo apho enye irutu yi-3.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.explain: Irutu engeyiyo yolingano lwe-quadratic neekoyifishenti zokwenyani ivela kunye ne-conjugate yayo, kwaye irutu 2 + √3 yolingano lwe-quadratic neekoyifishenti eziimilinganiselo ivela kunye ne-2 − √3. Xa iikoyifishenti ziyinkimbinkimbi, okanye zezokwenyani nje, irutu engenangqiqo ayikuvumeli ukumisela enye irutu njenge-conjugate yayo.

y-m-36-05.title: Uluhlu lwe-k olusebenza kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x
y-m-36-05.topic: Imeko yokuba ukungalingani kwe-quadratic kubambe kuwo onke amanani okwenyani, nexabiso lemida
y-m-36-05.goal: Hlula ukuba isiphumo sokukhangela amaxabiso ambalwa bubungqina okanye ngunqina, uze uqinisekise ukuba ixabiso lemida libandakanywa okanye hayi kuxhomekeke ekubeni uphawu lokungalingani lu-> okanye ≥.
y-m-36-05.material: Gqiba inyathelo ngenyathelo uluhlu lwe-k apho ukungalingani x² − 4x + k > 0 kubamba kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x. (Funda njenge: x squared kuncitshiswe 4x kudityaniswe k likhulu kune-0) Kunikwa isiqwenga esinye solwazi ngalo lonke ixesha.
y-m-36-05.thinking.0: Gweba ukuba isiphumo sokukhangela amaxabiso ambalwa sinokwenziwa isigqibo jikelele.
y-m-36-05.thinking.1: Faka ixabiso lemida ngokwakho ukugqiba ukuba libandakanywa na

y-m-36-05.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kokungalingani kwe-quadratic negrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic (inqanaba leyunithi yamalingano nokungalingani yeBanga 10) — H2 yalo msebenzi lilo kuphela inqanaba lobunzima nenkxaso kolu lwabiwo lwemveliso; ayithethi ukuba isicwangciso semfundo silabela loo mbandela kwelo banga. Cinga ukuba ulwazi lwangaphambili olungezantsi sele lufundiwe.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.prompt: Ngalo lonke ixesha kunikwa ulwazi, khetha "oko ungakuthetha kwinto eyaziwayo ngoku."
y-m-36-05.s.s1.hint.0: Faka ixabiso lemida ye-k ngqo kwintetho, uyibhale kwakhona ngendlela (x − 2)², uze ukhangele ixabiso layo kwi-x = 2.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.hint.1: Faka ixabiso elifanayo le-k kwimeko ye-> neyomeko ye-≥ uze uthelekise ukuba nganye ibamba na.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Ngo-k = 5, ukufaka x = −1, 0, 2, 3, 6 kunike amaxabiso entetho 10, 5, 1, 2, 17 ngokulandelelana, onke aphezulu.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Amaxabiso amahlanu ngubungqina obulungileyo, kodwa akukho kukhangela kwamanani onke okwenyani. Ukuba uyayazi imo yentetho (elona xabiso lincinci lale ntetho), ungaqiniseka, kwaye le ntetho inexabiso layo elincinci, i-1, kwi-x = 2, ngoko k = 5 isebenza ngenene.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kuba onke amaxabiso amahlanu aphezulu, singaqiniseka ukuba ibamba kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Esi sigqibo asikacingi ngomgama phakathi kwamachaphaza ama-5 akhangelweyo namanani onke okwenyani.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kunokwenzeka ukuba ibambe, kodwa amaxabiso amahlanu odwa awanakusenza siqiniseke.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Esi sigwebo sihlula phakathi kwamaxabiso ahloliweyo nesigqibo jikelele.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Esi sigwebo sithi alibambi kuba ixabiso lincinci, nangona ixabiso 1 lilungile. Oko ukungalingani kukufunayo kukuba ixabiso libe likhulu kune-0.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ukufaka amaxabiso amaninzi akuyi kusixelela, ngoko asikwazi ukugqiba.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Awuhlulanga umda wokufaka amaxabiso amaninzi kwinyani yokuba ubume bentetho buvumela ukuhlola.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Ukubona: ukufaka x = 2 kunika ixabiso lentetho 4 − 8 + k = k − 4. Kwaye ixabiso kwi-x = 2 lelona xabiso lincinci lale ntetho.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Uphawu lwelona xabiso lincinci k − 4 lumisela imeko. Ukuba k > 4, onke amaxabiso alungile, kwaye ukuba k < 4, liba ngaphantsi kwe-0 kwi-x = 2. Kumda k = 4, kufuneka uvavanye ngokuthe ngqo ukuze wazi ukuba ubandakanyiwe na.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Oku kukulindela ukuba elona xabiso lincinci k − 4 kufuneka libe likhulu kune-0.

y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Usenokuba ukhohlise i-k = 5 ohlolwe ngaphambili njengomda. Faka k = 4.5.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Oku kukulindela ukuba intetho ihlala ilungile xa k ilungile. Fumana ixabiso kwi-x = 2 xa k = 1.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Uvavanyo lomda: ukuba k = 4, intetho yi-x² − 4x + 4 = (x − 2)². Ixabiso kwi-x = 2 li-0, kwaye lilungile kuwo wonke omnye x.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kulungelelwano lokuqala x² − 4x + k > 0, ingaba k = 4 ikuluhlu?
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Ixabiso kwi-x = 2 li-0, ngoko "likhulu kune-0" alibambi. Ngoko k = 4 ishiyiwe kwaye uluhlu yi-k > 4. Ukuba ulindele b kwinyathelo elidlulileyo, olu vavanyo lutshintshe ukulindela kwakho, kwaye ukuba ulindele a, luqinisekise ukuba ukulindela kwakho kwakulungile.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ufunde "onke amanani okwenene" njenge-"phantse onke amanani okwenene."

y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ubunokugqiba ngokufaka ixabiso lomda ngokuthe ngqo, kodwa awukwenzanga.

y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ugwebe ukuba ukuba ukungalingani kuyasilela kwinqaku elinye, akubambi kuwo onke amanani okwenene.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.info: Utshintsho lwemeko: ngoku tshintsha uphawu lokungalingani ucinge ngo-k apho x² − 4x + k ≥ 0 ibambe kuwo onke amanani okwenene x.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.after: (x − 2)² ≥ 0 ibambe kuwo onke amanani okwenene x, ngoko k = 4 ikuyo kwaye uluhlu yi-k ≥ 4. Nakwintetho efanayo, ukuba ixabiso lomda libandakanyiwe okanye hayi kuxhomekeke ekubeni uphawu lu-> okanye ≥.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Ikuyo. Nokuba ixabiso kwi-x = 2 li-0, ≥ 0 ibambe.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Ugwebe ngokweemeko ukuba i-0 ivumelekile na kumda.

y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Awukhange uthathele ingqalelo ukuba uphawu lokungalingani lwahlukile kokungalingani kwangaphambili.

y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Ubunokugqiba ngokufaka k = 4 ngokuthe ngqo, kodwa awukwenzanga.

y-m-36-05.s.s2.prompt: Masisebenzise esi sigwebo kwingxaki entsha. Yeyiphi kwezi uluhlu lwe-k apho ukungalingani −x² + 6x + k < 0 kubambe kuwo onke amanani okwenene x?
y-m-36-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x = 3 uchaze ixabiso lentetho ngo-k. Cinga ukuba eli xabiso lelona nqaku liphezulu kwigrafu na.

y-m-36-05.s.s2.r.b: Ufumene elona xabiso likhulu le-−x² + 6x + k wagweba ukuba kufuneka libe ngaphantsi kwe-0.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.r.c: Awuhlolanga ukuba kumda k = −9 elona xabiso likhulu liba li-0, ukuze < 0 isilele.
